name: Nhut Thanh Chuong
summary: Nhút Thanh Chương is young jackfruit fiber, salted and fermented. The city portal calls it kim chi xứ Nghệ. In winter it is stir-fried with thịt lăn, or cooked alone. Thanh Chương is another commune. It is not a stall in the center.
origin: Thanh Chương. The city portal’s eight-specialty article and its food-culture page name it on the Nghệ table. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch describes the same ferment.
texture: The city portal says sour and crisp. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch says slightly sour and crisp.
howToEat: Eat it with rice. The city portal says it is sour and crisp, and that a little nước mắm is enough as a dip. In winter, stir-fry it with thịt lăn or cook it on its own. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch says shredded young jackfruit, salt, and a natural ferment, slightly sour and crisp, as a side. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Thanh Chương, not a Vinh street. A village lane was not printed. Check on arrival.
